verdict.rationale: Docs describe a 'Capacity Finder' in the Cloud Console that lets users compare placement availability across Zones for a requested instance type and node count before creating a Spot Node Pool, directly addressing pre-provisioning visibility into GPU availability, and quota docs describe how capacity limits/errors are surfaced. However, this is documented mainly in the context of Spot Node Pools rather than all instance types/regions uniformly, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming real-time accuracy or coverage across all GPU types and regions. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of Capacity Finder's real-time accuracy, evidence it covers on-demand/reserved capacity (not just Spot) across all regions.
